tooLarge: The content exceeds the {{max}} bytes limit.
integerBetween: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
nonNegative_zero: Enter a whole number greater than or equal to zero.

positive_zero: Enter a number greater than zero.
positive_one: Enter a number greater than zero with up to {{count}} decimal place.

object: The value must be an object.
color: Enter a hex color, such as #1f6feb.
currency: Enter a three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.
country: Enter the two-letter ISO country code.
domain: Enter a valid domain, such as acme.com.
datetime: Enter a valid date and time.
notFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
dateOrder: The end date cannot be before the start date.
key: Use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
unique: This value is already in use.
notMember: The user is not an active member of the organization.
